messages:
maria: Quick heads up — battlecard for 'Inference Econ' webinar needs rewrite. Angle: cost+latency story vs cloud AI endpoints & managed LLM APIs. Can we get a minimal one-pager + objection handlers? @aj @toma
aj: I'm up for it. thinking top claims: 1) predictable latency with dedicated routing 2) unit economics via batching+cache 3) graceful fallback across variants. keep it bite-sized.
liam: add procurement blockers: E2E SLA, data residency, KMS. customers ask about vendor lock-in and audit logs.
toma: product POV — include bench numbers: our p50 gen latency 45ms lower on short-context workloads vs X-managed; token cost delta ~35% with kv cache + quant. I'll DM detailed table.
eva: I'll make a one-slide artifact + 2x twitter-sized claims. Need final wording by EOD Thu.
maria: cool. @aj can you draft copy for claims + 3 objection scripts? keep language measurable: latency, cost, SLA.
aj: draft below, pls bikeshed:

- Predictable latency: 'Redwood gives consistent p95 latency within your SLA via dedicated pools and smart routing.'
- Better unit economics: 'Automatic prefix caching and workload-aware batching reduce token spend by up to 40% vs unmanaged endpoints.'
- Seamless degradation: 'Live fallbacks to compatible model variants keep apps online during capacity events.'

Objection scripts:
- 'We already use cloud provider endpoints' -> 'If you need predictable economics and SLOs at scale, Redwood lets you standardize across hosted/dedicated/private with rollback policies.'
- 'We're worried about vendor lock-in' -> 'We support open model variants and portable deployment options (VPC/on-prem) so you control execution.'

liam: add procurement line: 'SLA-backed uptime + optional KMS/HSM integrations'.
toma: small ask — add a short bench note: 'Our benchmark: 99th perc tail reduced by 20% through KV caching vs baseline.'
maria: great. next steps: @eva produce slide + 1-pager, @aj finalize copy, @liam draft procurement FAQ. Sync 30m tomorrow AM.
deploy-bot: Uploaded asset: https://redwood.internal/drive/inf-econ-battlecard-v2.pdf :paperclip:
maria: perfect — thanks everyone! :rocket:
